author: MrInsane
name: ChameleonMute
description: An alternative massmute cog for Meccha Chameleon games. Supports a recurring mute/unmute cycle with configurable whistle intervals, rate-limiting, and an interactive stop button.
install_msg: Thank you for installing ChameleonMute! Use `/chameleonmute start` to begin a recurring mute/unmute cycle.
short: Recurring mass mute and unmute for Meccha Chameleon games.
end_user_data_statement: This cog temporarily stores the Discord user IDs of members who are server muted during a game cycle to ensure they can be unmuted when the cycle is stopped or when they reconnect to voice.
